author: Brian Wilson
releaseNotes: 1.18.2 — Adds fault code 2102 to the default ignored-faults list, alongside 2103/2105. Confirmed live twice: both times it fired right as the vacuum was returning to charge after a room finished, with no visible problem either time -- same benign-charging-status pattern as the other ignored codes. Note: this only changes the default for new installs; existing installs keep whatever value is already saved in the app's 'Fault codes to treat as normal' field and need it updated by hand to pick up 2102.
